description: REPRODUCTION CLAIM: routes explicit reproduction claims to the expensive two-voter screen. Four arms: (1) a title beginning Replication Report or Reproduction Report; (2) computational/robustness reproduction or reproducibility OF a target in the title; (3) an active first-person or this-paper reproduce claim with a prior-work cue within 100 characters, together with a comment/reply/reanalysis/replication/reproduction title; (4) an explicit self-claim to conduct, assess or test computational reproduction/reproducibility within 80 characters. The bounded auxiliary/adverb list avoids species-that-reproduce and passive copyright boilerplate. The prior-work cue is syntactic, not proof that a named original was re-tested; report titles can also describe deposits or protocols. It assigns no vocabulary or eligibility verdict. Strict admission is required: population precision has not been independently measured. The 2026-11-10 offline canonical replay of the 5,146,160-row pool with its overlay, aliases, first-row order and text gate adds 217 formerly pending works to screening, including 68 pending I4R DPs; no current discard changes pile. Precedence 734 yields to the narrower live replication claims (735-760) and structural discards (935-960), outranks the fallible not-a-study-type crosswalk (500), and leaves the broad reproduction-signal rule in shadow. See docs/i4r-rule-promotion.md for the replay and scope limits.
